title: Rational open direct image preserves finite-constant-model constructibility
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$; all schemes are separated of finite type over $k$ and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in it. Let $\Lambda=E$, with the condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], or $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], pulled back to each scheme as in [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] which is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every $K\in\Dbc(U,\Lambda)$, where $\Dbc$ is the finite-constant-local-model bounded constructible category of [sk-def-sfb-constructible] and $Rj_*$ is the derived module direct image of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], one has $Rj_*K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$.

source.place: Integral coefficients paragraph and rational coefficients paragraph: derived-complete open direct image, integral generators, bounded continuity, and rational finite-subextension extension

proof.text: Use [sk-thm-sfb-qlbar-two-colimit](4) on U and X. Its finite-field and algebraic-closure clauses identify the finite-constant-model bounded-constructible predicates with the existing ring-object bounded-constructible predicates. The characteristic is ringChar k, positive because it is prime, and differs from ell by the standing hypothesis.

Regard j as a morphism between U and X over Spec k. For finite E, convert the input using the equality on U, apply [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves] with the continuous E coefficient ring, and convert the output using the equality on X. The finiteness-coefficient instance for E is supplied by its finite-dimensional normed Q_ell-algebra structure. This is a specialization of the existing general direct-image statement, not a new coefficient comparison.

Repeat the preceding conversion, direct-image preservation, and reverse conversion with the algebraic-closure coefficient ring, using its finiteness-coefficient instance and the algebraic-closure equality from [sk-thm-sfb-qlbar-two-colimit](4). Pair the two assertions. Both use the actual ordinary right derived lowerStar functor, with no transport of the morphism or coefficient action.

proof_origin.place: Rational open-image assertion, using the shorter existing general direct-image preservation theorem and the finite-coefficient descent predicate equalities, clause (4).
